ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR(ISPICKVAL( Status__c , "Shipped"),ISPICKVAL( Status__c , "Purchased"),ISPICKVAL( Status__c , "Returned")) , ISNULL( Actual_Delivery_Date__c ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: "Actual Delivery Date" is required when Status is "Shipped" /"Purchased"/"Returned"
